repo.outputPurpose: Gap analysis between the generated OSRS Clan Hub Admin mockups and the current frontend/backend implementation.

purpose: Scope and rewrite-risk assessment for adapting the current SwedesClanTracker feature/ui-overhaul branch toward the OSRS Clan Hub Admin mockups.

scopeDefinitions.likelyInScopeForMvp: Can be implemented mostly in the frontend or by reshaping existing API DTOs without changing the core data model heavily.
scopeDefinitions.heavyRewrite: Requires new persisted domain entities, richer worker collection, app-facing mutation endpoints, or replacing generic lifecycle/event metadata with structured records.
scopeDefinitions.likelyOutOfScope: Expands the project into a different product area, depends on unavailable third-party/manual data sources, or is mostly decorative/admin functionality with unclear value.

likelyInScopeForMvp.why: Mostly frontend CSS/component work. Existing surfaces already exist and can be relabeled/restyled.
likelyInScopeForMvp.recommendedScope: Implement app shell, sidebar labels, top sync bar, OSRS-style cards, table styling, and basic icons using safe custom assets.
likelyInScopeForMvp.backendNeed: Optional shell metadata only; can start with existing /api/app/home and /api/status.

likelyInScopeForMvp.why: The Members surface and /api/app/roster already exist.
likelyInScopeForMvp.recommendedScope: Ship the OSRS table layout first with current fields, then add combat/total/build once backend supports them.
likelyInScopeForMvp.backendNeed: No rewrite for visual phase; DTO extension later.

likelyInScopeForMvp.feature: Admin queue restyle using existing generic cases
likelyInScopeForMvp.why: Existing admin queue and review endpoints can be reused visually.
likelyInScopeForMvp.recommendedScope: Render current merge/missing cases as cards, but mark advanced confidence metrics as future backend work.
likelyInScopeForMvp.backendNeed: Potential app-facing wrappers for existing review actions.

likelyInScopeForMvp.feature: Rank review UI from existing PromotionCandidate workflow
likelyInScopeForMvp.recommendedScope: Create a dedicated tab/page backed by existing /api/promotions endpoints before inventing a new model.
likelyInScopeForMvp.backendNeed: Light DTO improvements for reason, risk, and supporting evidence.

likelyInScopeForMvp.why: LifecycleEvent data already exists and can be projected into a nicer table.
likelyInScopeForMvp.recommendedScope: Normalize display mapping in frontend first; only later standardize event metadata.

heavyRewriteFeatures.whyHeavy: Current PlayerSnapshot stores only TotalLevel, EHB, EHP, Collections, and PetCount. The mockups need per-skill snapshots, total XP, combat level, boss KC, and historical deltas.
workerSupportNeeded: Collect total XP, combat level, per-skill levels/XP, and boss KC from a reliable source.
Persist historical snapshots often enough to compute weekly deltas.
Classify stale/not-found/synced states from sync outcomes.
coreSupportNeeded: Add TotalXp and CombatLevel to snapshots or latest-player projection.
Add BossKcSnapshot for per-boss historical values.
Add sync/audit run records for freshness and failure reasons.
apiSupportNeeded: Extend roster/profile/home DTOs with total XP, combat, skill summaries, boss KC, last gain, sync reason.
Support time-window aggregation for weekly XP and boss KC.
heavyRewriteFeatures.recommendation: Do not block UI overhaul on this. Add DTO placeholders or feature flags, then implement stats collection as a separate backend milestone.

heavyRewriteFeatures.whyHeavy: Current merge suggestion appears to use simple snapshot deltas and generic metadata. The mockup requires repeatable confidence scoring and structured comparison components.
workerSupportNeeded: Calculate confidence using multiple signals: total XP, total level, EHP/EHB, boss KC, collection count, pets, and source freshness.
Persist candidate comparisons rather than only emitting generic lifecycle events.
coreSupportNeeded: Add RenameReviewCase / RsnChangeCandidate entity or structured metadata schema.
Persist confidence score, score breakdown, old/new player references, and decision status.
apiSupportNeeded: Add POST link/reject/reassign/ask-member endpoints or app-facing wrappers around existing review endpoints.
heavyRewriteFeatures.recommendation: Implement a basic card UI using current evidence first. Treat advanced confidence scoring as a dedicated backend feature.

heavyRewriteFeatures.whyHeavy: Some counts can be derived now, but XP/KC/log accuracy requires richer historical snapshots and standardized worker events.
workerSupportNeeded: Persist historical stat deltas and collection-log freshness.
coreSupportNeeded: Add stat history models and SyncRun/AuditRun models.
Create aggregate query support for weekly windows.
apiSupportNeeded: Return status freshness and confidence/accuracy metadata.
heavyRewriteFeatures.recommendation: Start with KPIs derivable from existing data: tracked members, stale members, pending reviews, last sync. Add XP/KC cards once snapshots exist.

heavyRewriteFeatures.feature: Player profile timeline, notes, and rich recent activity
heavyRewriteFeatures.whyHeavy: Profile history is currently marked unavailable. Admin notes and rich drops are not present as first-class models.
workerSupportNeeded: Emit durable rank-change and relevant player activity events.
Ingest drops only if a source exists.
coreSupportNeeded: Add RankHistory or durable rank lifecycle projection.
Add DropLog/SplitLog only if product scope includes drops.
apiSupportNeeded: Add rank history and player activity endpoints.
heavyRewriteFeatures.recommendation: Admin notes are a reasonable isolated addition. Drops/splits should not be bundled into the first profile rewrite.

heavyRewriteFeatures.feature: Action workflows and worker job queue
heavyRewriteFeatures.whyHeavy: Buttons require reliable mutation endpoints, background job orchestration, progress reporting, idempotency, auth, and error handling.
coreSupportNeeded: Add Job/AuditRun/SyncRun records if actions are asynchronous.
Record who triggered actions and their result.
apiSupportNeeded: Add mutation endpoints for sync, audit, add member, export, and cache clear only where real behavior exists.
Return job IDs and polling endpoints for long-running actions.
heavyRewriteFeatures.recommendation: Keep non-existing quick tools hidden or disabled. Wire only actions that already exist or are cheap to implement.

likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.reason: This turns the tracker into a PvM loot ledger. It requires manual entry, Discord bot ingestion, or another external source, plus money/value normalization.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.frontendImpact: Recent drops/splits can be mocked visually, but real tables/forms would be a separate product module.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.backendImpact: Requires DropLogEntry/SplitLogEntry entities, APIs, validation, audit trail, and possibly item price data.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.recommendation: Out of scope for the UI overhaul. Revisit as a separate PvM module.

likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.reason: Competitions require rules, participants, scoring windows, leaderboards, start/end states, and anti-abuse rules.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.frontendImpact: Dashboard can show a read-only 'active competition' placeholder later.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.backendImpact: Requires Competition, CompetitionParticipant, ScoreSnapshot, and leaderboard APIs.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.recommendation: Out of scope unless competitions are already a core project goal.

likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.reason: Current data appears to store collection count, not individual unlocked items. Item-level logs need a reliable source and much larger storage/projection surface.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.frontendImpact: Keep 'Collection Log Sync' as a high-level count/health KPI.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.backendImpact: Requires per-item collection-log schema, sync source, and potentially item metadata.

likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.reason: The app has no clear messaging channel. Asking a member would require Discord, email, in-app notifications, or another communication integration.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.frontendImpact: Button can be hidden, disabled, or converted to 'Copy message'.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.backendImpact: Requires member contact mapping, message dispatch, delivery status, and privacy considerations.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.recommendation: Out of scope unless Discord integration is already planned.

likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.reason: Useful, but not central to rendering the OSRS UI and could distract from tracker/domain work.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.frontendImpact: Top-right admin display can be static or sourced from existing auth session.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.backendImpact: Requires user/role/permission model and notification persistence.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.recommendation: Keep basic auth/logout. Defer notification center and fine-grained permissions.

likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.reason: This is only meaningful if the app has a real cache that admins should clear. Otherwise it is cargo-cult admin UI.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.backendImpact: Should not add fake endpoint. Add only if a real cache and operational need exist.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.recommendation: Out of scope unless current infrastructure has a cache layer.

likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.reason: The app should remain an unofficial tracker and avoid depending on official/copyrighted game UI art.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.frontendImpact: Use custom OSRS-inspired icons, CSS borders, and color language instead.
likelyOutOfScopeFeatures.recommendation: Out of scope. Keep the design inspired but original.

include: OSRS visual shell and component design system
Dashboard restyle using currently derivable stats
Roster restyle with existing fields plus graceful placeholders
Admin queue card layout using existing evidence
Rank review UI using existing promotion endpoints
defer: Player rank history and admin notes
Async job queue for full sync/audit actions
excludeForNow: Clear temp cache unless real cache exists
